subject.title: feat(wizard): deliver progress over the RPC wizard protocol

question: Should wizard progress frames preserve clients that submit answers for every returned step, or is this PR allowed to make progress unanswerable for all RPC clients?
rationale: The code can be repaired either way, but choosing an additive compatibility path versus a deliberate client contract break is a maintainer protocol decision.

options.title: Preserve Progress-Answering Clients
options.body: Tolerate progress answers server-side or update bundled clients in the same change so existing RPC wizard consumers keep advancing.

options.title: Accept The Contract Break
options.body: Require clients to re-poll without an answer for progress steps, with explicit rollout proof and documentation before merge.

options.title: Pause For Umbrella Direction
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until the broader wizard RPC parity issue settles the permanent progress-step semantics.

recommendation.title: Preserve Progress-Answering Clients
recommendation.body: Tolerate progress answers server-side or update bundled clients in the same change so existing RPC wizard consumers keep advancing.

likelyOwner.reason: The history connects this owner to the original wizard/session path and the current onboarding direction that affects the protocol decision.
